scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings src test *.ts && yarn --cwd functions lint
scripts.test:rules: yarn firebase emulators:exec --project demo-poorinter --only firestore,database "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.check:smoke: yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn --cwd functions typecheck && yarn --cwd functions test
scripts.check: yarn fmt:check && yarn lint && yarn check:smoke && yarn build:bundle
scripts.deploy: yarn build && yarn firebase deploy --project poop-rinter --only hosting
scripts.emulators: yarn --cwd functions build && yarn firebase emulators:start --project demo-poorinter --only auth,firestore,database,functions
scripts.functions:shell: yarn --cwd functions build && yarn firebase functions:shell --project poop-rinter
